engine_version_stamping.mechanism: ios/BenchmarkApp/scripts/stamp_engine_pins.sh (xcodegen preBuildScripts on both targets + bootstrap step 8) records the OBSERVED vendored state — git describe of each Vendored/ clone, the CLiteRTLM binaryTarget zip+checksum from LiteRT-LM's Package.swift, the llama.xcframework.tag sidecar — into Vendored/engine-pins.json, which the app target bundles as a resource (declared script output -> Copy Bundle Resources -> codesign); BenchmarkResult carries the arm-under-test's pin as engineVersion/engineArtifact (schema v1). Revised 2026-08-13 from the original post-build Info.plist mutation: that undeclared edit raced the build graph on incremental builds (key dropped after ProcessInfoPlistFile reruns; signature invalidated when codesign did not rerun). Observed state, not env defaults: requested tags and vendored reality drift (v0.13.1 clone ships v0.13.0 engine zips). Mac yardstick CLI: BENCH_ENGINE_PINS_FILE=ios/BenchmarkApp/Vendored/engine-pins.json. Unreadable pin => omitted => row records nil, never a guess.
engine_version_stamping.note: this lockfile remains the per-capture pin REGISTRY (what should be vendored); the stamp is the per-row WITNESS (what actually was) — regression tracking (condition 3) joins rows on the witness
